# nemau load-balancer

Load balancers, listeners, TLS certificates, pools and health monitors.

## Usage

```
nemau load-balancer [command]
```

Alias: `lb`

## Subcommands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [certificate](nemau_load-balancer_certificate.md) | TLS certificates for TERMINATED_HTTPS listeners |
| [flavors](nemau_load-balancer_flavors.md) | List the load-balancer tiers and their prices |
| [instance](nemau_load-balancer_instance.md) | Manage load balancers |
| [listener](nemau_load-balancer_listener.md) | Manage listeners |
| [pool](nemau_load-balancer_pool.md) | Manage pools, members and health monitors |

## Global options

```
      --api-url string           API origin (default: $NEMAU_API_URL, then https://api.nemau-cloud.com)
      --idempotency-key string   key making a write safe to repeat: 1-128 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : - (default: generated)
  -o, --output string            output format: table, json (default "table")
      --project string           target project, by id or by name (default: $NEMAU_PROJECT_ID, then the saved project)
  -q, --quiet                    print ids only
      --timeout duration         how long to wait for one operation (default 30m0s)
      --wait                     wait for asynchronous operations to finish (default true)
```
